subject: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightway.health>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and the numbers I promised. I want to capture the ask so we can get a scoped pilot/estimate over the next 48 hours.

Call notes (short):
- Use case: patient triage + internal search reranking for care pathways; embeddings for similarity search across clinical notes; chat for clinician-facing assistant.
- Target Q2 pilot: 3–6 week technical pilot, then expand to production if ok.

Volume & model mix (your estimate during call):
- Expected steady-state token consumption for pilot: ~25,000,000 tokens / month
  - Chat (interactive clinician assistant): ~15M tokens (60%)
  - Embeddings (indexing + queries): ~7.5M tokens (30%)
  - Rerank (top-k scoring during search): ~2.5M tokens (10%)

Target unit economics (what you said):
- Target blended $/1M tokens: $80–$120 (target mid = $100)

Preliminary pricing bands (informal; will send formal quote):
- Chat (large context, low-latency): $110 / 1M tokens (hosted)
- Embeddings: $22 / 1M tokens (note: embeddings often priced per vector; converting to equivalent token-based proxy here)
- Rerank (compute-heavy scoring): $400 / 1M tokens

Blended illustration at your stated mix:
- (15M*$110 + 7.5M*$22 + 2.5M*$400) / 25M = $104.40 per 1M tokens (blended)
- Estimated monthly pilot spend (25M tokens): ~$2,610 / month at these bands

Key constraints and priorities you shared:
- Cost cap for pilot ideally <= $3k / month
- Latency SLO: chat <= 500ms P95, embeddings lookup <= 100ms
- Data security: must not ship PHI to public model variants (prefer dedicated or Private with customer-managed VPC if pilot accesses real PHI)

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll assemble a formal one-page quote + token-model breakdown and send by EOD tomorrow (attached: preliminary estimate + model breakdown).
2) Technical sync with your eng lead (30m) to lock SLOs and replication strategy — can we tentatively schedule for Tue 5/4?
3) If pricing & SLOs look good, we’ll draft a short pilot contract (30-day trial, with optional 12-month commitment pricing band to meet $/1M target).

Attachments referenced: RW-estimate-BrightWay-20270502.pdf, token-model-breakdown-v1.xlsx

Short ask for you: can you confirm the 25M/month estimate (or update) and whether the pilot will include real PHI? That determines hosting option (hosted vs dedicated vs Private).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor | Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightway.health>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot

Neha —

Thanks for the write-up, this is exactly what I needed. A couple quick clarifications:
1) The 25M/month is our conservative pilot projection (we may spike in week 1 to ~40M while reindexing historical data).
2) Pilot WILL include de-identified patient notes initially; production will require PHI controls.

Can you:
- Send the formal quote and the doc that outlines what is permitted with hosted vs dedicated vs Private (we need that for procurement)?
- Confirm whether a 30-day pilot with a short commitment can still get us into the $100/1M band, or if we’ll need a 12-month commit to achieve that level.

If everything checks out, we can loop in procurement and infra next week.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee | Head of Data Products, BrightWay Health
samantha@brightway.health | +1 (646) 555-8812

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot

Markus / Monica —

Forwarding Samantha’s reply. They may spike to ~40M in initial week and pilot includes de-identified PHI (production will need PHI). Procurement will ask hosted vs dedicated vs Private distinction and what triggers price breaks.

Can you please:
- Prepare a 1-page formal estimate (attachment: RW-estimate-BrightWay-20270502.pdf) with two scenarios: (A) hosted pilot (30d, no commit) and (B) pilot with 12-month commit (discounted bands).
- Provide clear note on which option supports PHI for pilot (Private or Dedicated with customer-managed VPC).
- Confirm we can meet the target blended ~$100/1M with a 12-mo commit and what minimum commit that requires.

Priority: cost cap <= $3k/month for pilot; latency SLOs as below.

Thanks — Neha

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot

Neha / Monica —

Draft pricing bands and notes (high level):
- Hosted (30-day pilot, no commit):
  - Chat: $130 / 1M tokens
  - Embeddings: $30 / 1M tokens
  - Rerank: $450 / 1M tokens
  - Blended (25M mix): ~$125 / 1M -> est monthly ~$3,125 (may spike to ~$5k for initial reindex week at 40M)
- Committed (12-month):
  - Chat: $100 / 1M tokens (requires minimum 12-mo commit equating to 15M tokens/month average)
  - Embeddings: $20 / 1M tokens
  - Rerank: $350 / 1M tokens
  - Blended (25M mix): ~$94 / 1M -> est monthly ~$2,350

PHI & hosting:
- Pilot with de-identified notes: can run on Hosted if customer signs Data Processing Agreement and we enable dedicated tenant settings.
- Production with PHI: recommend Dedicated or Private deployment (VPC + KMS). That is a procurement conversation; I’ll add a short paragraph in the estimate.

Attachments I’m including for the email to the customer: RW-estimate-BrightWay-20270502.pdf (one-page quote) and token-model-breakdown-v1.xlsx (volume math and blended cost). I’ll also call out the minimum commitment requirement to hit the $100/1M band: 12 months at 15M/month baseline or a 6-month ramp with an average of 12M/month.

LMK if you want me to reduce the chat price further for pilot to be more competitive; we can do a limited-time pilot credit instead of price cuts.

-Markus
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightway.health>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call summary: cost & service split for BrightWay pilot

Samantha —

Attached is the one-page formal estimate (RW-estimate-BrightWay-20270502.pdf) and the token-model-breakdown workbook. Key callouts:
- Hosted 30-day pilot (no commit) estimated spend: ~$3,125 / month (covers spikes up to 40M).
- 12-month commit pricing band to hit target blended ~$94 / 1M tokens -> est ~$2,350 / month at 25M mix.
- Pilot with de-identified notes: hosted is feasible; production with PHI should use Dedicated or Private (we included language and the steps).

Links / next steps:
- Quote & sign: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DP-4392
- Tech sync: can we do Tue 5/11 at 10:00am PT for the engineering deep-dive? If that works I’ll calendar invite your eng lead and ours.

If procurement needs a 1-pager comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private, I can send that along — want me to include it in the DocuSign packet?

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Neha Kapoor
